meeting_end_after_start.name: meeting_end_after_start
meeting_end_after_start.value: "meeting"."ended_at" is null or ("meeting"."started_at" is not null and "meeting"."ended_at" >= "meeting"."started_at")

seal_evaluation_subject.name: seal_evaluation_subject
seal_evaluation_subject.value: ("seal_evaluation"."subject_kind" = 'barco' and "seal_evaluation"."barco_org_id" is not null and "seal_evaluation"."affiliate_id" is null) or ("seal_evaluation"."subject_kind" = 'afiliada' and "seal_evaluation"."affiliate_id" is not null and "seal_evaluation"."barco_org_id" is null)

seal_result_subject.name: seal_result_subject
seal_result_subject.value: ("seal_requirement_result"."subject_kind" = 'barco' and "seal_requirement_result"."barco_org_id" is not null and "seal_requirement_result"."affiliate_id" is null) or ("seal_requirement_result"."subject_kind" = 'afiliada' and "seal_requirement_result"."affiliate_id" is not null and "seal_requirement_result"."barco_org_id" is null)

ticket_satisfaction_range.name: ticket_satisfaction_range
ticket_satisfaction_range.value: "ticket"."satisfaction" is null or ("ticket"."satisfaction" between 1 and 5 and "ticket"."status" = 'resuelto')
